formNote: Mojidata IDS: ⿰白鬼 (from the database, 2026-11-05). This describes the graph’s parts, not its history; the etymology is not yet researched.
summary: The heavy soul that stays with the body and returns to earth; also the dark part of the moon.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Newton–Leipnik trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 魂 takes the highest of the eight points and 魄 the lowest, after the Liji’s 魂氣歸于天，形魄歸于地. A design choice, not a claim.

oc.note: Placeholder, NOT an Old Chinese reconstruction. Consult Baxter–Sagart 2014 before entering a form.

satellites.title: The Bodily Soul Returns to Earth
satellites.evidence: The Liji: 魂氣歸于天，形魄歸于地 — at death the breath-soul returns to heaven and the bodily soul to earth. The two souls part toward where each belongs.
